label: Change (4h)

label: Change (1d)
gloss: the frame price against the open of the 1d bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 1d bar open) / 1d bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes; the 1d bar opens at the UTC day's 00:00, so this is the change since that open — not a rolling 24h change
